chunks: Then, surely upon Us is its exposition.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the exposition of the Quran rests upon God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores God's absolute authority in guiding humanity, often linked to the role of the Imams as the living embodiment of divine clarification. It highlights that while the message is revealed, its precise interpretation and implementation remain under divine jurisdiction, ensuring the preservation of truth without distortion.
